Features Scholarships in Japan for Canadian students April 29, 2026 – Japan's Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT) is offering scholarships to Canadian students wishing to pursue their studies at a Japanese university. De Chastelain Scholarship Programme available to Canadian scholars March 20, 2026 – Canadian scholars have until May 11, 2026 to apply for short-term research opportunities on the island of Ireland, supporting collaboration and knowledge exchange on themes related to peace and reconciliation. Deadline approaching: Emerging Leaders in the Americas Program March 17, 2026 – Canadian postsecondary institutions have until March 31, 2026, to submit an application to Global Affairs Canada’s Emerging Leaders in the Americas Program (ELAP) for the 2026-2027 academic year!
